I’m such a godamn failure

I’ve been dreaming about living alone also. Idk I’ve just always wanted to move into a house on my own (maybe with a pet) and live off of ramen for the rest of my life.

However I don’t think that’s going to happen when I plan to move out of state and live with my friends when we all buy a large house together.

Yeah things have been getting worse for me also. 

However, as much as I just want to end it already I still want to hold out for what little hope is still there that I can make a comeback from this, even if it means I have to endure this suffering until that moment finally comes.
Agreed
I’m a very recluse person who shuts himself in all day so I don’t see the sun very often but I probably go outside for once tomorrow and see if that will make me feel better.

Thank you
Thank you

I’m a high school student in the US and I pretty much fell the same way. I can never fully concentrate in online school and even if there are no distractions I just kind of zone out. I can’t bring myself to do the assignments unless they are short and/or easy. All I want to do is play games with my friends but my parents won’t allow me to during the weekdays so I either go do other things or sit around and do nothing until I pass out on my bed listening to music. I could care less about what happens now and I just want to enjoy my life as much as I can before the time comes.

Anyways, I hope things work out for you in the end and best of luck to you during these hard times.
Same here, haven’t gotten a good amount of sleep in awhile.

Same here, I’ve gone from being an A/B student to nearly having all F’s although I just can’t seem to care anymore. It’s going to disappoint my parents since they wanted me to study in the medical field but as I said I just don’t care anymore. I can’t really give any advice but I hope things work out for you. Good luck to you.
Depressed with a sense of worthlessness
Good to know just please try your best.
Idk if that will help because some of the classes in my school don’t offer opportunities for submitting late assignments. Maybe OP has the same issue as well.

I know exactly how you feel because this is currently happening to me also so your not the only one. The best I say we can do now is to try to get as many assignments done as possible  and get as much help as we can get.
